# Gustavo Cruz

> Gustavo Cruz is a Brazilian software engineer focused on backend systems in production, with eight years in technology and four years building with C# and .NET.

He currently works at DXC Technology. His experience covers software engineering, infrastructure and application security. This portfolio is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/): Primary version of the portfolio
- [Portuguese portfolio](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/pt/): Brazilian Portuguese version
- [Experience](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/#experiencia): Professional history and verified outcomes
- [Projects](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/#projetos): Selected public and independently developed work
- [Education](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/#formacao): Degree, MBA and postgraduate education
- [Contact](https://gcruz.geg.dev.br/#contato): Email, calendar, LinkedIn and GitHub
